caseName: Wall v. Old Colony Trust Co.
caseNameFull: Eliza A. Wall, in Error v. Old Colony Trust Company
summary: In error to the Supreme Judicial Court of the State of Massachusetts.
attorneys: Mr. L. L. Soaife for the plaintiff in error. Mr. Felix Baokemmin, Mr. Moorfeld Story, Mr. Ezra R. Thayer, Mr. J. L. Thorndike and Mr. L. S. Dahney for the defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction on the authority of Eustis v. Bolles, 150 U. S. 361; and see Wall v. Old Colony Trust Company, 174 Massachusetts, 340; 177 Massachusetts, 275.
